mapper.select: /* 이메일로 회원 조회 */ SELECT USR_SN, USR_LOGIN_ID, USR_PSWD_HASH, USR_REFRESH_TOKEN_HASH, USR_NM, USR_EML_ENC, USR_EML_HMAC, USR_EML_CERT_YN, USR_TELNO_ENC, USR_ADDR_ENC, USR_DADDR_ENC, USR_ZIP_ENC, USR_BANK_NM_ENC, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC, USR_PRFL_FL_SN, USR_STATUS_CD, USR_ROLE_CD, USR_ADULT_CERT_YN, USR_ADULT_CERT_DT, USR_USE_YN, USR_REG_DT, USR_UPDT_DT, USR_REG_ID, USR_UPDT_ID FROM USERS WHERE USR_EML_HMAC = #{emailHmac}

SELECT USR_SN, USR_LOGIN_ID, USR_PSWD_HASH, USR_REFRESH_TOKEN_HASH, USR_NM, USR_EML_ENC, USR_EML_HMAC, USR_EML_CERT_YN, USR_TELNO_ENC, USR_ADDR_ENC, USR_DADDR_ENC, USR_ZIP_ENC, USR_BANK_NM_ENC, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC, USR_PRFL_FL_SN, USR_STATUS_CD, USR_ROLE_CD, USR_ADULT_CERT_YN, USR_ADULT_CERT_DT, USR_USE_YN, USR_REG_DT, USR_UPDT_DT, USR_REG_ID, USR_UPDT_ID FROM USERS WHERE USR_EML_HMAC = #{emailHmac} FOR UPDATE

SELECT USR_SN, USR_LOGIN_ID, USR_PSWD_HASH, USR_REFRESH_TOKEN_HASH, USR_NM, USR_EML_ENC, USR_EML_HMAC, USR_EML_CERT_YN, USR_TELNO_ENC, USR_ADDR_ENC, USR_DADDR_ENC, USR_ZIP_ENC, USR_BANK_NM_ENC, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC, USR_PRFL_FL_SN, USR_STATUS_CD, USR_ROLE_CD, USR_ADULT_CERT_YN, USR_ADULT_CERT_DT, USR_USE_YN, USR_REG_DT, USR_UPDT_DT, USR_REG_ID, USR_UPDT_ID FROM USERS WHERE USR_LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT USR_SN, USR_LOGIN_ID, USR_PSWD_HASH, USR_REFRESH_TOKEN_HASH, USR_NM, USR_EML_ENC, USR_EML_HMAC, USR_EML_CERT_YN, USR_TELNO_ENC, USR_ADDR_ENC, USR_DADDR_ENC, USR_ZIP_ENC, USR_BANK_NM_ENC, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC, USR_PRFL_FL_SN, USR_STATUS_CD, USR_ROLE_CD, USR_ADULT_CERT_YN, USR_ADULT_CERT_DT, USR_USE_YN, USR_REG_DT, USR_UPDT_DT, USR_REG_ID, USR_UPDT_ID FROM USERS WHERE USR_SN = #{usrSn}

SELECT USR_SN, USR_LOGIN_ID, USR_PSWD_HASH, USR_REFRESH_TOKEN_HASH, USR_NM, USR_EML_ENC, USR_EML_HMAC, USR_EML_CERT_YN, USR_TELNO_ENC, USR_ADDR_ENC, USR_DADDR_ENC, USR_ZIP_ENC, USR_BANK_NM_ENC, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC, USR_PRFL_FL_SN, USR_STATUS_CD, USR_ROLE_CD, USR_ADULT_CERT_YN, USR_ADULT_CERT_DT, USR_USE_YN, USR_REG_DT, USR_UPDT_DT, USR_REG_ID, USR_UPDT_ID FROM USERS WHERE USR_SN = #{usrSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.USR_SN AS userSn, u.USR_LOGIN_ID AS loginId, u.USR_NM AS nickname, u.USR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, status_code.CMM_NM AS statusName, u.USR_ROLE_CD AS roleCode, role_code.CMM_NM AS roleName, u.USR_USE_YN AS useYn, COALESCE(report_count.REPORT_COUNT, 0) AS reportCount, u.USR_REG_DT AS registeredAt, u.USR_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE status_code ON status_code.CMM_CD = u.USR_STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE role_code ON role_code.CMM_CD = u.USR_ROLE_CD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RPTD_USR_SN, COUNT(*) AS REPORT_COUNT FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE RPTD_USR_SN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RPTD_USR_SN ) report_count ON report_count.RPTD_USR_SN = u.USR_SN
ORDER BY u.USR_REG_DT DESC, u.USR_SN DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.USR_SN AS userSn, u.USR_LOGIN_ID AS loginId, u.USR_NM AS nickname, u.USR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, status_code.CMM_NM AS statusName, u.USR_ROLE_CD AS roleCode, role_code.CMM_NM AS roleName, u.USR_USE_YN AS useYn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ABUSE_REPORT report WHERE report.RPTD_USR_SN = u.USR_SN) AS reportCount, u.USR_REG_DT AS registeredAt, u.USR_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE status_code ON status_code.CMM_CD = u.USR_STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE role_code ON role_code.CMM_CD = u.USR_ROLE_CD WHERE u.USR_SN = #{usrSn}

SELECT USR_SN AS userSn, USR_LOGIN_ID AS loginId, USR_NM AS nickname FROM USERS WHERE USR_SN IN
#{userSn}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM USERS WHERE USR_LOGIN_ID = #{loginId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM USERS WHERE USR_NM = #{nickname})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM USERS WHERE USR_EML_HMAC = #{emailHmac})
mapper.update:
/* 프로필 기본 정보 수정 */ UPDATE USERS SET USR_NM = #{nickname}, USR_PRFL_FL_SN = COALESCE(#{profileFileSn}, USR_PRFL_FL_SN), USR_EML_ENC = #{emailCiphertext}, USR_EML_HMAC = #{emailHmac},
USR_BANK_NM_ENC = NULL, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC = NULL,
USR_BANK_NM_ENC = COALESCE(#{bankNameCiphertext}, USR_BANK_NM_ENC), USR_ACNT_NO_ENC = COALESCE(#{accountNoCiphertext}, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC),
USR_TELNO_ENC = #{telnoCiphertext},
USR_ZIP_ENC = NULL,
USR_ZIP_ENC = COALESCE(#{zipCiphertext}, USR_ZIP_ENC),
USR_ADDR_ENC = NULL,
USR_ADDR_ENC = COALESCE(#{addressCiphertext}, USR_ADDR_ENC),
USR_DADDR_ENC = NULL
USR_DADDR_ENC = COALESCE(#{addressDetailCiphertext}, USR_DADDR_ENC)
WHERE USR_SN = #{usrSn}

/* 회원 탈퇴 - 상태 전환 + 보존 데이터 컬럼별 처리 */ UPDATE USERS SET USR_STATUS_CD = 'USRC0003', USR_TELNO_ENC = NULL, USR_ADDR_ENC = NULL, USR_DADDR_ENC = NULL, USR_ZIP_ENC = NULL, USR_BANK_NM_ENC = NULL, USR_ACNT_NO_ENC = NULL, USR_EML_ENC = #{anonymizedEmailCiphertext}, USR_EML_HMAC = #{anonymizedEmailHmac}, USR_NM = #{anonymizedNickname}, USR_PRFL_FL_SN = NULL WHERE USR_SN = #{usrSn}
